limits: Catalog fixture advertises the named Codex tier as gpt-6.1-luna, while the Luna evaluation seat is runtime-verified gpt-6-luna. Selection is checked against the advertised fixture; this is not proof of current live catalog resolution.
Skill is explicitly loaded into both arms. This measures follow-through, not trigger discovery.
Only the three requested routing cases are live-measured. Profile selection and unavailable-model cases are definitions only.
Scoring checks first dispatch, selected named model, explicit default service settings, and no pre-dispatch media commands. It does not score worker-brief quality or actual video findings.
Codex subscription has no incremental API spend; its list-price dollars are unmeasured.
Five repetitions of each prompt are not five independent task types.
High-tier partial work started under the original brief and was stopped on the ladder amendment; it is retained locally outside these comparative arms.
Cells are T3 stub seats: measured dispatch is delegate_task; the Claude terminal Agent route was not live-tested.
Final8a records score routing/model/settings only. Stub dispatch does not execute worker fan-out or video analysis; workflow-entry-only invocation is not separately measured.
No new baseline or higher-tier runs were performed; prior 70dd912e candidate and confirm rows are history only.

measures.default_settings: First dispatch explicitly sets serviceTier: default for the Codex case, or fastMode: false for the Claude case, independent of model match and ordering.
measures.control_correct: No dispatch and default media pipeline attempted on the unnamed case.
